source_title: Gumroad Price Change Is A Huge Disappointment For Thousands Of Builders B6587015B5

snippets.snippet_text: "As a seller in the 3% tier I'm now paying around 750 USD per month in fees. This is going to 3250 USD / month in February. Around 40K a year. I don't know what they're smoking."

possible_subjects: IndieHackers forum post (December 2022) about Gumroad pricing change: seller in the 3% tier was paying $750/month in fees; new flat fee pricing would increase cost to $3,250/month ($40,000/year) effective February 2023; strong negative seller reaction to the announced change
